items.quote: Integration: fernhill-sso (single sign-on for the customer Fernhill Outfitters)
Area: SAML assertion mapping in fernhill-sso
Deployed the certificate rollover change in fernhill-sso to staging, looks good.
Writing handover notes for fernhill-sso and oncall-runbook this week.
- fernhill-sso depends on auth: the SAML certificate for the customer rolls over once a year, two weeks before it expires, following the steps in DOC-14
- Oskar Alvarez no longer owns fernhill-sso

SELECT count(*) AS n FROM (SELECT id, author, ts, text, refs FROM WLWT_CHAT.chat) s
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM (SELECT id, author, ts, text, refs FROM wlwt_tickets.tickets) s
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM (SELECT d.id AS id, d.author AS author, d.ts AS ts, d.text AS text, d.refs AS refs FROM wlwt_docs.docs_raw LATERAL VIEW explode(docs) x AS d) s

SELECT * FROM (SELECT 'chat' AS source, s.id, s.author, s.ts, s.text FROM (SELECT id, author, ts, text, refs FROM WLWT_CHAT.chat) s WHERE s.text LIKE '%fernhill-sso%' UNION ALL SELECT 'ticket' AS source, s.id, s.author, s.ts, s.text FROM (SELECT id, author, ts, text, refs FROM wlwt_tickets.tickets) s WHERE s.text LIKE '%fernhill-sso%' UNION ALL SELECT 'doc' AS source, s.id, s.author, s.ts, s.text FROM (SELECT d.id AS id, d.author AS author, d.ts AS ts, d.text AS text, d.refs AS refs FROM wlwt_docs.docs_raw LATERAL VIEW explode(docs) x AS d) s WHERE s.text LIKE '%fernhill-sso%') u ORDER BY u.ts

SELECT c.id AS chat_id, c.refs AS ref, t.id AS ticket_id, d.id AS doc_id FROM (SELECT id, author, ts, text, refs FROM WLWT_CHAT.chat) c LEFT JOIN (SELECT id, author, ts, text, refs FROM wlwt_tickets.tickets) t ON c.refs = t.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT d.id AS id, d.author AS author, d.ts AS ts, d.text AS text, d.refs AS refs FROM wlwt_docs.docs_raw LATERAL VIEW explode(docs) x AS d) d ON c.refs = d.id WHERE c.refs <> '' AND (t.id IS NOT NULL OR d.id IS NOT NULL)
